title: Projektetage Affiliation Abbreviation Morph Order
summary:
Affiliations step 3 now morphs full university names into place via hidden data-id anchors before showing abbreviated labels, matching presentation morph rules.

- AffiliationsMorphView renders a morph-source h4 (paired by reveal.js) plus a visible abbreviated h4 without data-id.
- CSS keeps morph sources in layout but opacity-0 for correct FLIP pairing.
- Extended intro DOM tests; core and react renderer tests pass.
